assertions: TaskGWT2KJ enables native SID_CELL_FORMAT_RESET26067 through existing shared Writer Clear menu/shortcut,ScCellShell,ScViewFunc,ScDocFunc and original concrete DeleteCell/DeleteContent operation owners. Actual ScAttrArray::DeleteHardAttr clears direct item ids except merge/merge flags,retains unbound style names and source parent itemsets,reuses default patterns and re-searches coalesced runs. Source table deletion visits only allocated columns;default-column tails remain unchanged. Actual ScUndoDeleteContents owns attribute snapshots,marks,flags and native Delete history;scalar text/numbers/formulas and listeners remain with original cell owners. Independently authored ODS and repeated package reopen exercise cleared properties. Only the represented plain-cell/default-sheet-view HARDATTR|EDITATTR path is supported;rich edit,style resolution,protection,matrix/merged-range expansion,conditional formatting,drawing,alternate views and full native service/parity are unverified. Existing browser primary saving/open/no-recovery policies remain.

Source EDITATTR undo snapshots also copy ordinary STRING blocks through the consumed native CopyToColumn/CopyByCloneHandler path,including cross-pool re-interning,empty-string removal markers and no setter broadcasts;HARDATTR-only undo does not restore strings.

stackDivergence.rationale: Shared Writer React controls bind actual native items and source slot identities; intentional primary storage and no-recovery behavior is retained.
